comment: Explicit no-regression baseline for the /api/v2 OpenAPI contract (Task 2.1 of the 2026-08-27 console-CLI integration plan). Entries are deterministic 'METHOD path: detail' strings derived from contracts/radas-api-v2.openapi.json. Tests fail on any NEW violation not listed here. Pre-existing auto-proxied legacy endpoints carry undocumented path parameters because they mirror hand-written v1 routes without schemas; they are ratcheted here and shrink as domains gain explicit schemas (Task 2.3). Regenerate this file and the snapshot together, only with a reviewed diff.
